host_galaxy.comment:
Hjorth+2012: TOUGH Table 3 identified host. Redshift note='\\nodata', reference(s)='\\nodata'; E/AE/AE* denote host emission-line redshifts, A/A* afterglow absorption spectroscopy, and P afterglow photometric redshift. Host R/Ks magnitudes are observed Vega magnitudes, uncorrected for foreground extinction; upper-limit confidence levels were not stated.
Perley+2013: Perley+2013 Tables 1–2 identified host; Single emission-line identification supported by photometry (mixed single-line+photometric method); redshift_type is null because AJST cannot represent the mixed method. The separate z_phot=1.52 (+0.30/-0.36) is a 1-sigma estimate and is not substituted for z=1.551. Host coordinates use the RAH/DEH columns, not the afterglow RAJ2000/DEJ2000 columns. Table 3 magnitudes are uncorrected for foreground Galactic extinction; measurement errors are 1 sigma. Figure 3 describes the upper limits as 2 sigma.
Krühler+2015: Host emission-line spectroscopy from the X-shooter sample; no per-source redshift uncertainty is stated in the CDS table. Paper Table 2 reports two components at z=1.5585 and z=1.5597; the CDS aggregate value z=1.5590 is used. Coordinates are J2000 eq_FK5 positions from Simbad via the CDS/VizieR table, not new astrometry measured by this paper. The paper states that fluxes, spectra, and photometry are corrected for Galactic foreground reddening; incidental AB magnitudes therefore have gext_corr=true.
Hjorth+2012: Source access: arXiv v2 Table 3 TeX was used after the IOP VoR/MRT route was blocked; this is a documented substitution.
Krühler+2015: Source access: CDS/VizieR J/A+A/581/A125 plus arXiv HTML for paper-only values and appendices; the A&A full-text route returned 403.
Merged-field decision: host coordinates taken from Hjorth+2012 according to the direct-measurement priority rule.
Merged-field decision: redshift, error, and type taken as one tuple from Krühler+2015 according to the recency/method priority rule.
